draft:
**Commercial Flexibility**

We offer the full spectrum of commercial models and have the experience to recommend the right structure for each phase of your programme. For a Dutch utilities company, we designed a hybrid model that applied fixed-price discipline to well-scoped deliverables — Phase 1 discovery and Phase 3 go-live — while preserving time-and-materials flexibility during the iterative design phase. The result was a reduction of €340K in client budget risk compared to a fully fixed-price contract.

**Radical Cost Transparency**

Cost surprises damage trust. Our approach is to eliminate them. Throughout the Dutch utilities engagement, we operated a monthly cost dashboard directly accessible to the client's CFO office, complemented by weekly burn-rate alerts triggered at 80% of any budget milestone. Finance had full visibility at all times.

**For This Engagement**

We will propose a phase-appropriate commercial structure during contract negotiation, calibrated to your budget certainty requirements and the inherent scope variability of each workstream.
